project_summary.name: Todo API
project_summary.description: A RESTful API for managing to-do items, supporting CRUD operations with filtering, sorting, and input validation, built with FastAPI and tested with pytest.
project_summary.target_users: Developers integrating task management into applications
business_goals: Provide a reliable and efficient task management API
Ensure data integrity through validation and error handling
Enable easy integration with client applications

entities.name: TodoItem
entities.description: Represents a single to-do task with title, description, priority, due date, and completion status.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.constraints: optional, must be in the future

actors.name: API Client
actors.description: Any application or user making HTTP requests to the API
goals: Create, read, update, delete to-do items

functional_requirements.name: Create Todo Item
functional_requirements.description: Create a new to-do item with title, description, priority, and due date.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: POST /todos with valid data returns 201 and the created item.
AC2: POST /todos with missing title returns 422 validation error.
AC3: POST /todos with invalid priority returns 422.
AC4: POST /todos with past due_date returns 422.

functional_requirements.name: List Todo Items
functional_requirements.description: Retrieve a list of to-do items with optional filtering by completion status and priority, and sorting by due_date or priority.
acceptance_criteria: AC2: GET /todos?completed=true returns only completed items.
AC3: GET /todos?priority=high returns only high priority items.
AC4: GET /todos?sort_by=due_date&order=asc returns items sorted ascending by due_date.
AC5: GET /todos with invalid sort_by returns 422.

functional_requirements.name: Update Todo Status
functional_requirements.description: Update the completion status of a specific to-do item.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: PATCH /todos/{id} with body {"completed": true} returns 200 and updated item.
AC2: PATCH /todos/{id} with non-existent id returns 404.
AC3: PATCH /todos/{id} with invalid body returns 422.

functional_requirements.name: Delete Todo Item
functional_requirements.description: Delete a specific to-do item by its ID.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: DELETE /todos/{id} returns 204 and removes the item.
AC2: DELETE /todos/{id} with non-existent id returns 404.

  44|### ADR-002: Left-to-Right Evaluation Without Precedence
  45|
  46|- **状态**: Accepted
  47|
  48|- **背景**: Chain calculation order of operations ambiguity [RISK-02]
  49|
  50|- **决策**: Evaluate chain calculations strictly left-to-right without operator precedence
